text:
anya_pm: Quick thread to finalize the rollout approach for per-tenant exemptions + safety ladder. Customers want short-lived opt-outs and a minimal ops flow.
sam_sre: TL;DR: implement a 3-step safety ladder — (1) hard kill, (2) switch to compact model variant, (3) soft-rate-limit/queue. Each action must emit `safety_action{tenant,step,reason}`.
devops_ops: Flag surface proposal: `tenant_safety_enabled` (global) + `tenant_safety_mode:<tenant_id>` (off|kill|compact|queue) that supports TTL and an approver note. UI should allow CSV bulk load for pilots.
rowan_devex: SDK behavior: read precedence tenant > region > global. Provide helper `getTenantSafetyMode(tenant)` that returns resolved mode and expiry. Keep API and UI surface minimal.
julia_sales: From sales: pilots need a one-click 24h exemption without legal paperwork. Ops should be able to approve TTL exemptions with RBAC (CS reps whitelist).
sam_sre: Alerts/telemetry: emit `safety_active{tenant}`, `safety_degraded_pct{tenant}`, and `safety_global_degraded_pct`. Alert rules: global_degraded_pct > 0.5% for 30m OR any tenant_degraded_pct > 5% in 5m. Auto-kill: if global alert fires, flip `tenant_safety_enabled=false` and notify oncall.
anya_pm: Launch must-haves: flags + SDK, ops TTL UI with audit trail + RBAC, SLOs & alerts, automated kill-switch, replay job to estimate impact, and canary in two regions. Nice-to-have: self-serve permanent exemptions in console.
rowan_devex: Canary plan: phase A = 5% us-west for 2h, phase B = 10% eu-west for 24h. Also run an internal A/B: 10% degraded traffic uses `compact` vs `queue` to compare latency and quality proxies.
sam_sre: Replay job: run against last 48h logs to predict how many tenants would hit each tier. If replay >15 tenants for tier 2 historically, add a 1% intermediate throttle step.
julia_sales: I'll collect top pilot tenants and request pre-registration. Please support TTL=24h for initial exemptions.
devops_ops: Flag contract sketch: ```feature: tenant_safety_v1
flags:
 - tenant_safety_enabled: boolean
 - tenant_safety_mode:<tenant_id>: string (off|kill|compact|queue) // supports ttl and approver
precedence: tenant > region > global
```
canary-bot: started canary in us-west-2 at 2025-02-12T14:05:00Z (5% traffic) :rocket:
anya_pm: Action items: @rowan_devex - SDK+flag reader PR (ETA Wed). @sam_sre - replay job + alerts (ETA Thu). @devops_ops - TTL UI prototype + RBAC (ETA Wed EOD). @julia_sales - pilot list (ETA Tue). I'll finalize thresholds and runbook Thu EOD.
sam_sre: Also add cost delta metric for `compact` model in canary so finance can estimate.
rowan_devex: Noted, will emit `canary_cost_delta` in logs.
anya_pm: Great. We'll reconvene after phase A and the replay results. If replay shows many impacted tenants we'll throttle and re-evaluate. Thanks all.
